Data, privacy and security architecture

A source-linked technical walkthrough. Trace the flow, explain the boundary, then test the failure path.

After this session, you can:
  • Describe data classification and residency
  • Trace purpose limitation
  • Name security operations

Technical flow

Every hand-off is a control boundary: on failure the flow holds, refers or denies — it never skips ahead.

  1. 01Classify + purpose
  2. 02Collect minimum
  3. 03India-resident encrypted store
  4. 04Role-scoped use
  5. 05Retention / legal hold
  6. 06Export or erasure evidence

1. Data contract

India residency, tenant partitioning, purpose limitation, retention and subject-rights workflows apply across records, documents, events and telemetry. Aadhaar biometric, OTP and PID artifacts are prohibited from storage.

2. Security

Secrets, encryption, key custody, session controls, step-up, device certification, redaction, vulnerability management, incident response and forensic custody form the operating boundary around domain controls.

3. Lifecycle

Access, correction, erasure/legal-hold, export and exit must preserve regulatory records and audit integrity. Data products and CDC are purpose-separated; analytics cannot become a cross-tenant escape hatch.
